tie_rule: omit; do not label equal scores

pass_count_dpo.name: equal-weight executable pass-count
pass_count_dpo.interpretation: one point for each legal query not falsely rejected and one point for each same-root buggy query distinguished without a correct-RTL false positive

scalar_score_dpo.name: fixed-safety-weighted scalarization
scalar_score_dpo.interpretation: a false positive costs twice one rewarded same-root detection, matching the Pilot requirement that fixed false positives must not increase

prohibitions: no held-out or test outcome in scoring
no dominance predicate used by either scalar baseline
